$schema-note: Advisories intentionally accepted by the mobile-security gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs). Each key is a GitHub advisory ID; the value documents why it is accepted and when to revisit. Anything NOT listed here that is moderate+ still fails CI. See SECURITY-NOTES.md.

GHSA-h67p-54hq-rp68.reason: Transitive via cosmiconfig@5 (Expo/Metro config loading). The fix requires js-yaml 4.x, but cosmiconfig@5 calls the removed safeLoad/safeDump API, so forcing it breaks the Metro/Expo build. Quadratic-complexity DoS in YAML merge-key handling only affects parsing of attacker-controlled YAML, which is not part of the runtime mobile app (build-time tooling only).
GHSA-h67p-54hq-rp68.remediation: Resolved by the React Native / Expo / Metro major upgrade tracked in SECURITY-NOTES.md (newer @expo/metro-config pulls cosmiconfig>=8, which uses js-yaml 4.x).
